films.title: A Trip to the Moon
films.overview: Professor Barbenfouillis and five of his colleagues from the Academy of Astronomy travel to the Moon aboard a rocket propelled by a giant cannon. Once on the lunar surface, the bold explorers face the many perils hidden in the caves of the mysterious planet.

films.title: The Impossible Voyage
films.overview: Using every known means of transportation, several savants from the Geographic Society undertake a journey through the Alps to the Sun which finishes under the sea.

films.title: The Kingdom of the Fairies
films.overview: At the royal court, a prince is presenting the princess whom he is pledged to marry when a witch suddenly appears. Though driven off, the witch soon returns, summons some of her servants, and carries off the princess. A rescue party is quickly organized, but the unfortunate captive has been taken to a strange, forbidding realm, from where it will be impossible to rescue her without some special help.

films.title: The Black Imp
films.overview: A traveler at an inn is harassed by a mischievous devil in his room.

films.title: The Mermaid
films.overview: A magician conjures up a mermaid while fishing.

films.title: The Monster
films.overview: An Egyptian prince has lost his beloved wife and he has sought a dervish who dwells at the base of the sphinx.

films.title: The Infernal Cauldron
films.overview: A green-skinned demon places a woman and two courtiers into a flaming cauldron.

films.title: The Four Troublesome Heads
films.overview: One of the greatest of black art pictures. The conjurer appears before the audience, with his head in its proper place. He then removes his head, and throwing it in the air, it appears on the table opposite another head, and both detached heads sing in unison. The conjurer then removes it a third time. You then see all three of his heads, which are exact duplicates, upon the table at one time, while the conjurer again stands before the audience with his head perfectly intact, singing in unison with the three heads upon the table. He closes the picture by bowing himself from the stage.

films.title: Bluebeard
films.overview: A young woman becomes the eighth wife of the wealthy Bluebeard, whose first seven wives have died under mysterious circumstances.

films.title: An Up-to-Date Conjurer
films.overview: A film from Méliès has him playing a magician who does a few tricks including making a woman disappear.

films.title: The One-Man Band
films.overview: A band-leader has arranged seven chairs for the members of his band. When he sits down in the first chair, a cymbal player appears in the same chair, then rises and sits in the next chair. As the cymbal player sits down, a drummer appears in the second chair, and then likewise moves on to the third chair. In this way, an entire band is soon formed, and is then ready to perform.

films.title: The Diabolic Tenant
films.overview: A man rents an apartment and furnishes it in remarkable fashion.

films.title: The Eclipse: Courtship of the Sun and Moon
films.overview: In this film, Méliès concocts a combination fairy- and morality tale about the foolishness of trying to look too deeply into the workings of an unstable and inscrutable universe. At a medieval school, an old astronomer begins to teach a class of young men, all armed with telescopes, about the art of scrutinising an imminent eclipse. When a mechanical clock strikes twelve, all the young men rush to the windows and fix their telescopes on the heavens.

films.title: The Melomaniac
films.overview: The leader of a marching band demonstrates an unusual way of writing music.

films.title: The Man with the Rubber Head
films.overview: A chemist carries out a bizarre experiment with his own head.

films.title: The Infernal Cake-Walk
films.overview: Pluto, having seen the earth, comes back home amazed at the success of that well-known dance, the "cake-walk." He has brought back with him two noted well-known dancers, who start their favorite dance amidst the flames.

films.title: The Vanishing Lady
films.overview: Georges Méliès makes a woman disappear, then reappear.

films.title: After the Ball
films.overview: A woman arrives home after the ball. Her servant helps her undress and bathe.

films.title: Divers at Work on the Wreck of the "Maine"
films.overview: Divers go to work on a wrecked ship (the battleship Maine that was blown up in Havana harbour during the Spanish-American War), surrounded by curiously disproportionate fish.

films.title: A Terrible Night
films.overview: A man tries to get a good night's sleep, but is disturbed by a giant spider that leaps onto his bed, and a battle ensues in hilarious comic fashion.

films.title: Playing Cards
films.overview: Three friends are playing cards in a beer garden. One of them orders drinks. The waitress comes back with a bottle of wine and three glasses on a tray. The man serves his friends. They clink glasses and drink. Then the man asks for a newspaper. He reads a funny story in it and the three friends burst out laughing while the waitress merely smiles.

films.title: A Nightmare
films.overview: A man has a fantastical nightmare involving, among other things, a grinning malevolent moon.

films.title: The Bewitched Inn
films.overview: A weary traveler stops at an inn along the way to get a good night's sleep, but his rest is interrupted by odd happenings when he gets to his room--beds vanishing and re-appearing, candles exploding, pants flying through the air and his shoes walking away by themselves.

films.title: The Astronomer's Dream
films.overview: An astronomer has a terrifying dream.

films.title: The Temptation of St. Anthony
films.overview: St. Anthony is tempted by visions of women, including one that is transformed from the image of Jesus Christ Himself!

films.title: The Devil in a Convent
films.overview: A priest is officiating at a convent, when suddenly he is transformed into the devil, who frightens away the nuns and turns the place into pandemonium.

films.title: The Pillar of Fire
films.overview: A devil wearing bat-like wings and brandishing a trident dances around a giant pot, conjuring forth flame from his trident to lit a fire beneath the pot. After the devil works the fire with bellows, an angelic woman emerges from the pot. The devil and the pot vanish as the woman performs a dance, waving about her diaphanous sleeves until she conjures forth another fire, then she rises amongst the smoke into the air.

films.title: The Magician
films.overview: In this scene is shown a magician behind an ordinary table, upon which he suddenly and mysteriously causes to appear a large box, into which he leaps. The sides of the box fall to the ground, but instead of containing the magician a lively clown steps forth who further mystifies the audience by causing the box to disappear, and in its place is seen a fully laid table with a smoking dinner, to which the clown applies himself. The table, however, suddenly disappears much to the astonishment of the clown, who is confronted by the magician in the garb of Mephistopheles. This he suddenly changes to that of a sculptor, and in the background is seen a pedestal with the bust of a young lady, which comes to life as the sculptor applies the mallet and chisel.

films.title: Joan of Arc
films.overview: A divinely inspired peasant woman becomes an army captain for France and then is martyred after she is captured.

films.title: The Fat and Lean Wrestling Match
films.overview: A series of fantastical wrestling matches.

films.title: Going to Bed Under Difficulties
films.overview: A man takes off his clothes in preparation for bed, only for new clothes to spontaneously generate, leading to comical consternation.

films.title: Cinderella
films.overview: A fairy godmother magically turns Cinderella's rags to a beautiful dress, and a pumpkin into a coach. Cinderella goes to the ball, where she meets the Prince - but will she remember to leave before the magic runs out?  Méliès based the art direction on engravings by Gustave Doré. First known example of a fairy-tale adapted to film, and the first film to use dissolves to go from one scene to another.

films.title: The Dreyfus Affair
films.overview: The first movie ever censored for political reasons. The title refers to the then contemporaneous Dreyfus affair in which a Jewish military officer was falsely convicted of treason, and it was alleged that he was framed due to anti-semitism.

films.title: The Conquest of the Pole
films.overview: A science fantasy film that deals with an extraordinary race to the north pole by rival parties of balloonists. Based on the novel "The Adventures of Captain Hatteras" by Jules Verne.

films.title: Le manoir du diable
films.overview: In a medieval castle, a dark magician thought to be Mephistopheles conjures up a series of bizarre creatures and events in order to torment a pair of interloping cavaliers.

films.title: The Merry Frolics of Satan
films.overview: Two travellers are tormented by Satan from inn to inn and eventually experience a buggy ride through the heavens courtesy of the Devil before he takes one of them down to Hell and roasts him on a spit.

films.title: Le château hanté
films.overview: A man has an encounter with several spooky apparitions in a castle that is evidently owned by the Devil.
